mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines similar figures?

options.A: Figures that have the same size but may have different shapes
options.B: Figures that have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides
options.C: Figures that are mirror images of each other
options.D: Figures that share at least one common side

mcqs.answer: Figures that have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides
mcqs.explanation: Similar figures are those in which each angle of one figure equals the corresponding angle of the other, and the lengths of corresponding sides are in the same proportion. Option B states exactly this. Option A describes congruent figures, C describes reflections, and D is unrelated.

mcqs.question: If ΔABC is similar to ΔDEF, which of the following correctly matches the corresponding vertices and sides?

options.A: A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F and AB ↔ DE, BC ↔ EF, CA ↔ FD
options.B: A ↔ E, B ↔ D, C ↔ F and AB ↔ ED, BC ↔ DF, CA ↔ EF
options.C: A ↔ F, B ↔ D, C ↔ E and AB ↔ FD, BC ↔ DE, CA ↔ EF
options.D: A ↔ D, B ↔ F, C ↔ E and AB ↔ DF, BC ↔ FE, CA ↔ ED

mcqs.answer: A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F and AB ↔ DE, BC ↔ EF, CA ↔ FD
mcqs.explanation: When two triangles are similar, the order of letters indicates correspondence. ΔABC ∼ ΔDEF means A corresponds to D, B to E, C to F, and consequently side AB to DE, BC to EF, and CA to FD. The other options mix the order incorrectly.

mcqs.question: Which condition guarantees that two triangles are similar by the AA (Angle-Angle) criterion?

options.A: Two sides of one triangle are proportional to two sides of the other triangle
options.B: Two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of the other triangle
options.C: All three sides of one triangle are proportional to the corresponding sides of the other triangle
options.D: One side and the included angle of one triangle are equal to those of the other triangle

mcqs.answer: Two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of the other triangle
mcqs.explanation: The AA similarity criterion states that if two angles of one triangle are respectively equal to two angles of another triangle, the triangles are similar. Option B expresses this directly. Option A describes a side proportion without angle information, C is SSS similarity, and D is SAS similarity.

mcqs.question: Triangle PQR has sides 6 cm, 8 cm, 10 cm. Triangle XYZ has sides 9 cm, 12 cm, 15 cm. Are the triangles similar by SSS similarity?

options.A: Yes, because the corresponding sides are in the ratio 3:2
options.B: Yes, because the corresponding sides are in the ratio 2:3
options.C: No, because the side ratios are not equal
options.D: No, because the largest side of one triangle is not opposite the largest angle

mcqs.answer: Yes, because the corresponding sides are in the ratio 2:3
mcqs.explanation: For SSS similarity, all three pairs of corresponding sides must have the same ratio. 6:9 = 2:3, 8:12 = 2:3, 10:15 = 2:3, so the ratio is 2:3 for all sides, confirming similarity. Option B states this correctly. Option A reverses the ratio, C is false, D is irrelevant.

mcqs.question: In ΔABC, AB = 5 cm, AC = 7 cm and ∠A = 60°. In ΔDEF, DE = 10 cm, DF = 14 cm and ∠D = 60°. Which statement is true?

options.A: The triangles are not similar because the side lengths are different
options.B: The triangles are similar by SAS similarity
options.C: The triangles are similar by AA similarity

mcqs.answer: The triangles are similar by SAS similarity
mcqs.explanation: SAS similarity requires the ratio of two corresponding sides to be equal and the included angles to be equal. Here, AB/DE = 5/10 = 1/2 and AC/DF = 7/14 = 1/2, and the included angles ∠A and ∠D are both 60°, satisfying SAS similarity. Hence option B is correct. Option A ignores the proportionality, C would need two angle equalities, D would need all sides equal.

mcqs.question: In ΔABC, a line through point D on AB is drawn parallel to AC, meeting BC at E. Which similarity criterion is most directly used to prove that ΔDBE ∼ ΔABC?

options.B: SSS similarity because DB/AB = DE/AC = BE/BC
options.C: SAS similarity because DB/AB = DE/AC and the included angle at D equals the angle at A
options.D: AAA similarity because all three angles are equal

mcqs.explanation: When a line through D is parallel to AC, corresponding angles are equal: ∠DBE equals ∠ABC and ∠DEB equals ∠ACB. With two pairs of equal angles, AA similarity is established. SSS or SAS are not needed because side ratios are not given. Option A correctly identifies the AA criterion.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about similar figures is FALSE?

options.B: Corresponding sides are in the same ratio
options.C: The figures must have the same area
options.D: The shape of the figures is the same

mcqs.answer: The figures must have the same area
mcqs.explanation: Similar figures have equal corresponding angles and proportional sides, so their shapes are the same, but their areas can differ (they scale by the square of the similarity ratio). Therefore, statement C is false. Options A, B, and D correctly describe properties of similar figures.

mcqs.question: Triangle MNO is similar to triangle PQR. If side MN corresponds to side PQ and side NO corresponds to side QR, which vertex of the first triangle corresponds to vertex Q of the second triangle?

options.D: Cannot be determined from the given information

mcqs.explanation: Correspondence of sides implies the vertices opposite those sides correspond as well. Since MN ↔ PQ, vertex O (opposite MN) corresponds to R (opposite PQ). Since NO ↔ QR, vertex M (opposite NO) corresponds to P (opposite QR). The remaining vertex N must correspond to Q. Hence option B is correct. The other options do not follow the side correspondence logic.
